text: In the process of debugging a VI, you have placed a breakpoint before Square Function VI as Shown below in order to Single-Step through the code When you suspend execution at that breakpoint, what will happen if you press the (Step Over) button?
options: LabVIEW will complete the execution of the current VI and return to the calling VI(if one exists)
LabVIEW will skip the execution of Square Function VI.in order to Step Over that function and continue single-stepping through the VI.
LabVIEW will open up the block diagram of Square Function VI to allow you to single step through the code inside the function
LabVIEW will execute the Square Function. I and then highlight the next node to be executes as you continue Single-Stepping through the VI.
